name: simplebeacon-vscode
description: Offline AI code audit — 48 analyzers + 25 scan engines, zero source-code upload, board-ready compliance reports for AI slop, credential leaks, and EU AI Act / SOC 2 gaps.

screenshots.label: AI Slop Cop sidebar with scan results and gate status
Detailed findings with file locations and fix suggestions
Full scan mode for comprehensive coverage
Exported scan report in JSON format

simplebeacon.licenseToken.description: Paste your SimpleBeacon license token from https://simplebeacon.ai/dashboard/#/profile to unlock Pro/Team features. This is the same token stored as sb_auth_token in the dashboard localStorage.

simplebeacon.autoScanOnOpen.description: Automatically scan workspace when opening VS Code

simplebeacon.offlineMode.description: Run SimpleBeacon in offline mode without external services

simplebeacon.showWelcomeOnLoad.description: Show the Welcome dashboard every time the AI Slop Cop extension loads

simplebeacon.displayMode.description: Where to display SimpleBeacon tabs: mainWindow = VS Code panel with tabs, sidebar = activity bar sidebar

simplebeacon.autoOpenPreviewPanel.description: Automatically open the standalone preview panel when the sidebar loads

simplebeacon.afterAnalysisAction.description: What to display after an analysis completes: none, notify, sidebar dashboard, or main window panel

simplebeacon.browserOpenMode.description: How to open dashboard and sidebar pages: simpleBrowser = VS Code webview panel, vscodeSimpleBrowser = VS Code Simple Browser with URL bar, externalBrowser = system default browser

simplebeacon.previewOpenMode.description: How to open the sidebar preview: externalBrowser = system default browser, vscodeSimpleBrowser = VS Code Simple Browser with URL bar, preview = VS Code built-in preview tab

simplebeacon.openInExternalBrowser.description: Open certificates and reports in the system default web browser instead of VS Code panels

simplebeacon.maxFiles.description: Maximum number of files to scan

simplebeacon.scanIncludeAllFiles.description: When true, scan all files in the selected path (disable built-in exclusions like test files and scripts).

simplebeacon.excludePatterns.description: Glob patterns to exclude from scanning

simplebeacon.analysisProfile.description: Analysis profile for enhanced AI analysis

enumDescriptions: Default sensitivity ?Çö all realtime rule engines enabled
AI slop patterns only ?Çö suppress security/code-quality noise
High-confidence only ?Çö suppress stylistic and low-confidence matches
simplebeacon.preset.description: Select the scanning sensitivity rule preset.

simplebeacon.confidenceThreshold.description: Minimum confidence level required to report an AI slop finding.

simplebeacon.minConfidence.description: Minimum confidence threshold for AI slop detection alerts (0.0 = all patterns, 1.0 = only explicit signatures). Overridden by confidenceThreshold when set.

simplebeacon.realtimeFileTypes.description: File types to monitor for real-time analysis

simplebeacon.realtimeSeverity.description: Minimum severity level for real-time issue detection

simplebeacon.realtimeDebounce.description: Debounce time in milliseconds for file analysis

simplebeacon.realtimeMonitorDirectory.description: Directory path to monitor for real-time changes. Leave empty to monitor the entire workspace.

simplebeacon.autoStartRealtime.description: Automatically start real-time monitoring when VSCode opens

simplebeacon.preferredAIProvider.description: Preferred AI provider for enhanced analysis

simplebeacon.ollamaUrl.description: Ollama server URL (e.g. http://localhost:11434). Falls back to OLLAMA_BASE_URL or LOCAL_AI_URL env vars.

simplebeacon.useEngineApi.description: Use the local SimpleBeacon engine API (localhost:3000) for real-time scanning. When enabled, the extension sends file content to the engine's full 48-analyzer suite. When disabled or engine unavailable, falls back to built-in local regex catalog. All communication is over localhost — no content leaves the machine.

simplebeacon.engineUrl.description: URL for the local SimpleBeacon engine API. Only used when useEngineApi is enabled. Default: http://localhost:3000

simplebeacon.engineTimeoutMs.description: Timeout in milliseconds for engine API requests. If the engine doesn't respond within this time, the extension falls back to local regex scanning.

enumDescriptions: No context guard — full content always sent to engine
Silently truncate content exceeding the threshold, no UI notification
Show a toast notification when content exceeds threshold, but still send full content
simplebeacon.contextGuardMode.description: Controls how the Context Guard handles large editor buffers before sending to the engine API. 'both' (default) shows a toast and truncates the payload to prevent slow scans.

simplebeacon.contextGuardMaxChars.description: Maximum character count for engine API payloads. When content exceeds this limit, the Context Guard truncates or warns based on contextGuardMode. Default: 4000 (safe for small local models).

enumDescriptions: No save-time agent validation. AI session detection disabled.
Use RealtimeMonitor rapid-file-change detection to validate saves only during AI editing sessions (default).
Always validate source files on save, regardless of AI session state. Useful for agents that edit slowly.
simplebeacon.agentDetectionMode.description: Controls when the Agent Guard validates files on save. 'heuristic' (default) uses the RealtimeMonitor's rapid-file-change detection to identify AI editing sessions and surfaces findings as VS Code diagnostics. The commit gate (pre-commit hook) remains the hard boundary regardless of this setting.

simplebeacon.agentModel.description: Ollama model name for enhanced analysis (e.g. llama3.2:latest). Falls back to AGENT_MODEL env var.

simplebeacon.apiServerUrl.description: SimpleBeacon API server URL for cloud sync and higher-tier features. (e.g. https://api.simplebeacon.ai)

simplebeacon.apiToken.description: JWT Bearer token for SimpleBeacon API authentication. Falls back to secret storage if empty.

simplebeacon.apiUrl.description: SimpleBeacon API server URL (legacy, use apiServerUrl).

simplebeacon.severityFilter.description: Minimum severity to show in the issues panel

simplebeacon.autoMonitorAI.description: Automatically start AI slop real-time monitoring when opening VS Code

simplebeacon.projectPath.description: Custom project path to scan. Leave empty to use the active workspace folder.

simplebeacon.pathMappings.description: Path mappings to reroute virtual/aliased directories to real hardware locations.

prefix.description: The aliased path prefix to match (e.g. C:\Virtual\Projects).

replacement.description: The real hardware path to substitute (e.g. J:\Real\Projects).

simplebeacon.relayPort.description: Port for the browser preview relay server (default 55444).

simplebeacon.dataServerPort.description: Port for the remote data API server. Exposes all extension data via HTTP/SSE on this port.

simplebeacon.deepScan.description: Deep scan mode ?Çö bypass docs/vendor/cache filters (only .simplebeaconignore + 500MB limit applies)

simplebeacon.includeDeps.description: Include node_modules and .git in scan (slower, more noise)

enumDescriptions: Full scan ?Çö all rule engines, full directory walk
Gate scan ?Çö production paths only, fast quality gate check
Quick scan ?Çö skip heavy AST engines, fastest feedback
simplebeacon.scanMode.description: Scan mode controlling depth and rule coverage

simplebeacon.localAgent.enabled.description: Use the SimpleBeacon Local Agent for scans when it is available on 127.0.0.1.

simplebeacon.syncToCloud.description: Upload scan reports to the remote SimpleBeacon server (configured via apiUrl or apiServerUrl) so the website dashboard displays the same results as the IDE.

simplebeacon.localAgent.autoInstall.description: Automatically download and install the local agent when the SimpleBeacon CLI is not found.

simplebeacon.localAgent.autoStart.description: Automatically start the installed local agent before scanning if it is not already running.

simplebeacon.localAgent.downloadUrl.description: Override URL for the local agent portable zip. Falls back to the configured API server or the public Render deployment.

simplebeacon.localAgent.port.description: Port the local agent listens on (default 55432).

simplebeacon.enableReferralPrompts.description: Show a subtle success prompt when a repository achieves a perfect 100/100 quality score.

simplebeacon.remoteMode.description: Run SimpleBeacon entirely in the browser. All panels and previews open in the browser preview window instead of VS Code: IDE panels.

simplebeacon.aiKeys.description: Stored AI provider keys and Ollama settings for the extension dashboard.

simplebeacon.enableDryRunOnSave.description: Automatically run a fix dry-run preview in the Output panel on document save (supported source files only). No files are modified.

simplebeacon.autoScanOnSave.description: Automatically run a fast local scan when a document is saved. Uses a debounce delay to avoid excessive scans.

simplebeacon.scanOnSaveDebounce.description: Debounce delay in milliseconds before triggering a scan after document save. Lower values = faster feedback but more CPU usage.

simplebeacon.diagnosticsSeverity.description: Minimum severity level for inline editor diagnostics (squiggles). 'all' shows every finding from critical down to low-severity AI slop patterns.

simplebeacon.teamTelemetry.enabled.description: Send anonymized team scan summaries to SimpleBeacon (paid/team tiers only). Never sends source code or file paths.

scripts.verify:all: npm run compile && node ../scripts/verify-scan.js && npx @vscode/vsce package --out simplebeacon-test.vsix
scripts.package:vsix: npm run compile && npm run sync:dashboard-web && npx @vscode/vsce package
scripts.arch:graph: depcruise src --config .dependency-cruiser.js --output-type dot | dot -T svg > architecture.svg
scripts.quality:check: npm run lint && npm run compile && npm run arch:validate && npm run test
